verdict.rationale: Pika documents a Language Swap app ("Same voice, new language") where you upload a speaking clip and get translated speech with voice matching and lip sync, which is the core of this story. The evidence comes only from brief first-party listings. missing for 10: in-depth documentation (supported languages for Language Swap, length limits, multi-speaker handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of voice and lip-sync quality.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over

citations.quote: Upload a speaking clip to create translated speech with voice matching and lip sync.
Language Swap: Same voice, new language
